title: Possible March continuation of Oaxaca normalista plantón/encampment
continuation_status: March 27 local report supports that normalista graduates were still occupying/blocking the same Armenta y López / Section 22 site and maintaining an automatic-hiring demand; this documents activity at that date but not uninterrupted presence since January/February. Threshold and final end remain unknown.
notes: This record tracks the adjacent-month lead only; it is not proof of a March gathering or threshold. January remains the possible event owner. March S015 is an opened local follow-up, not a separate March-onset candidate: it reports the same plantón/site on 27 March but no attendee count, and does not prove uninterrupted occupancy or closure.
open_questions: Did the encampment continue into March, pause, or end, and on what date?
Can a March local Oaxaca source identify the same group/site?
Was this still the same Jan/Feb episode, or a resumed action?
How many demonstrators were present simultaneously on 27 March or any other March date?
When did the plantón/blockade end, if it did?
